full_judgment: 4. The suit was contested by defendants Nos. 1-3 by filing a written statement contending, inter alia, that Manada Sundari inherited 2.34 acres of land in the suit khatian from her husband as life estate holder and the she transferred 1.51 acres of land to defendant Nos. 1 and 2 by registered deed of gift dated 13-12-88 and delivered possession thereof to them. The said defendants have been in peaceful possession of the suit land, the plaintiffs got no cause of action to file the suit and the same was liable to be dismissed.
